title: Moving-Average Filter
constraints: `dout = floor((x[n] + x[n-1] + x[n-2] + x[n-3]) / 4)` over the last 4 **accepted** samples (unsigned 8-bit).
A sample is accepted on a rising edge with `valid_in = 1`. That same edge updates `dout`, including the new sample.
Without `valid_in`, both the window and `dout` hold.
Synchronous reset: window full of zeros, `dout = 0`. Must be synthesizable.
hints: Keep a 4-entry shift register of samples.
The sum of four 8-bit values needs 10 bits. Dividing by 4 is just dropping the two LSBs.
A running sum (`sum + new − oldest`) avoids re-adding all taps. It is a nice optimization for long windows.
